description: 3M Company, incorporated in Delaware in 1929 to continue operations begun in 1902, is a diversified technology company with a global presence. It manages its continuing operations in three reportable business segments: Safety and Industrial, Transportation and Electronics, and Consumer. Its underlying businesses include abrasives, automotive aftermarket, electrical markets, industrial adhesives and tapes, industrial specialties, personal safety, roofing granules, advanced materials, automotive and aerospace, commercial branding and transportation, display materials and systems, electronics materials solutions, consumer safety and well-being, home and auto care, home improvement, and packaging and expression. 3M describes itself as among the leading manufacturers of products for many of the markets it serves, with most of its products involving expertise in product development, manufacturing and marketing.
